name: seatmark-app
description: SeatMark 座签 - 考场座位标签在线生成工具

scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && npm run prerender
scripts.prerender: vite build --ssr src/entry-server.ts --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:pages: vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build --base=/SeatMark/ && node --input-type=module -e "import { copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; copyFileSync('dist/index.html','dist/404.html')"
